name: Walevska Quantum VR
summary:
Walevska Quantum VR is a collection of immersive 3D environments built for Meta Quest.

Choose from eight scenes:
- Heights
- Enclosed space (elevator)
- Spiders
- Rats
- Cockroaches
- Messy room
- Crooked picture frames
- Room with an MRI machine

Each environment has its own sound effects, music and lighting. Simple controller input lets you move between scenes and return to the main menu at any time.

Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Access requires a Walevska Quantum account (quantumvr.com
